title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
method: Comparison of post-hoc probability calibration methods.
main_findings: Temperature scaling improved calibration on many evaluated datasets.
limitations: Nonclinical datasets; no guarantee under prevalence or domain shift.
Review covers the cited pages; quantitative tables require further source verification.
does_not_establish: No evidence that SMC ensemble probabilities are calibrated or clinically useful.
relevance_to_project: Separate ranking performance from probability and threshold validity.
